changelog.title: Multi-Cloud High Availability & Instant Zero-Lag Startup Architecture
highlights: Added multi-tier cloud failover topology supporting Supabase (Tier 1), Neon Serverless PostgreSQL (Tier 2), and Local SQLite NVMe replica (Tier 3)
Implemented automated high-speed migration tool replicating 83.4k+ master games, user games, hardware nodes, and AI logs to Neon
Optimized game library loading with Local-First Frame-0 instant render and non-blocking background synchronization
Added fast-abort 1.5s timeout on remote distributed server queries preventing UI cold-start stalls
Demoted startup auto-scans to non-intrusive background state to eliminate full-screen radar modal lockouts
Added automated Vercel keep-alive cron job to keep Supabase, Neon, and MongoDB warm 24/7

changelog.title: Ecosystem Optimization, Multi-Node Architecture & Dynamic Deduplication
highlights: Added Win32 working set RAM compaction (EmptyWorkingSet) dropping idle background memory to ~40-60 MB during gameplay
Implemented dynamic machine-unique Node ID derivation (NODE-<MAC_HASH>) and host discovery to prevent multi-device collision
Added canonical path-based deduplication (path_to_name) and feature merging across Steam, Epic, GOG, and custom disk scans
Implemented universal default library path discovery (_get_default_library_paths) across multi-drive storage
Non-destructive node_scan_paths synchronization preserving user custom scan paths across heartbeats
Delta-hashed library synchronization in node_service.py to prevent redundant network uploads
OpenCV configuration loader 3-tier runtime hooks ensuring 100% frozen PyInstaller stability

changelog.title: Telemetry & Rollback Subsystem Reliability Hardening
highlights: Fixed PowerShell script path interpolation and quotation parsing under UAC elevation for offline update rollback
Preserved 0% metric values in analysis engine to ensure accurate Idle load states and eliminate Unknown health classifications
Synchronized effective capture and DirectX FPS telemetry to system tray tooltip
Bound RightTelemetry neural metrics and status items to live backend telemetry
Fixed DatabaseManager class inheritance and Intel Arc Alchemist/Battlemage architecture profiling heuristics

changelog.title: OpenCV Resilience & Pipeline Stability Hardening
highlights: Removed unused cv2 import from capture/screen.py that caused crash on DLL load failure
Added try/except cv2 import guards in scene_classifier, simple_rules, and trt_inference with graceful NumPy/PIL fallbacks
Guarded all cv2 window management and frame encoding calls in pipeline_host to prevent AttributeError and NoneType crashes
Fixed dangling self._render_preview() call in _display_loop that caused AttributeError at runtime

changelog.title: Distributed Server Agent and Vision Connection Integration
highlights: Connected Agent and Vision UI pages to the central distributed library server with live node telemetry updates
Added Library Server online/offline pipeline status badges and stats panel overlays
Configured backend game scanner to fall back to distributed library server catalog API when direct DB access is unavailable

changelog.title: OpenCV Loader & Supabase Metadata Enrichment Fixes
highlights: Resolved OpenCV cv2 loader missing configuration in PyInstaller packages
Added full Steam features and authentic summaries backfill in Supabase
Streamlined AI classifier with zero-retry multi-provider failover

changelog.title: Distributed Cluster Architecture & Multi-Tenant User Isolation
highlights: Implemented high-performance distributed cluster architecture with Load Balancer and multi-instance microservices
Enabled strict multi-tenant library and node isolation per authenticated Clerk ID and OAuth provider
Backfilled release dates across canonical catalog and removed deprecated database schemas
Integrated live Docker Compose orchestration with Windows IPv6 network compatibility
Connected frontend distributed synchronization with automatic server model mapping

changelog.title: OpenCV Config Loader & PyInstaller Backend Fixes
highlights: Resolved OpenCV cv2 config loader missing module errors in PyInstaller backend packaging
Dynamic multi-environment package directory discovery fallback for rapidocr and cv2
Verified clean frontend and website production builds

changelog.title: Fix First-Launch Setup Loading & Backend Process Startup Loop
highlights: Resolved cascading backend kill-restart loop during cold boot and first launch
Standardized WebSocket bridge host to 127.0.0.1 to avoid Windows dual-stack socket collisions
Added concurrency mutex and graceful process management in Electron main process
Enabled full stdout and stderr traceback forwarding to app.log in production
Added persistent local app data directory creation in NSIS installer

changelog.title: Fix OpenCV config loader missing configuration in PyInstaller backend packaging
highlights: Dynamically collected OpenCV cv2 config.py runtime files, binaries, and RapidOCR data in PyInstaller spec
Added robust multi-environment package directory discovery fallback

changelog.title: AI Support Assistant, Community Benchmarks & Live Telemetry Reporting

Connected live community game ratings, rig reviews, and media uploads to MongoDB persistence layer
Added interactive documentation search, categorized guides, and API key management client
Introduced hardware telemetry reporting modal with automated system spec detection
Refined games tested benchmark profiles, DLSS 4/DLAA upscaler badges, and newsletter subscription pipelines

Enhanced junk keywords and container validation in library scanner
Connected community review media uploads and navbar active tab synchronization
